ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Fonts [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Fonts[/h1] [i]Client-side only.[/i] Registers the game's TextMeshPro font assets with TMP's material reference manager so they can be selected by name in rich text, including inside [b]ScriptedScreens[/b] labels: [code]<font="Name">[/code].
Stationeers ships its fonts in asset bundles, so TMP's name lookup never finds them and the tag errors out. This mod registers them directly. No game files are modified and ScriptedScreens is not patched.
[h2]Your own fonts[/h2] Drop [b].ttf[/b] or [b].otf[/b] files into [code]mods/ScriptedScreensFonts/Assets/fonts[/code] (subfolders are scanned) and they become available under the font's own name: [code]Barlow-Bold.ttf[/code] is [code]<font="Barlow Bold">[/code]. A restart is needed after adding files.
Each face is rendered once into a fixed character set: ASCII, Latin-1, and a set of UI symbols (dashes, maths, arrows, shapes, block bars, box drawing). Add anything else via [b]ExtraCharacters[/b] in the mod config. A glyph the font does not contain is skipped rather than substituted from another typeface.
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [/list]
[h2]Usage[/h2] Put the tag inside a label's text: [code]<font="Barlow Condensed">TANK 3 84%[/code]. It applies to the end of the string or until [code]</font>[/code].
Every available name is written to [code]BepInEx/LogOutput.log[/code] on load. Names are case sensitive; a name that does not resolve prints its tag literally.
